summary.para: If true, compares every vector at full precision. Only applies to the baseline, requires allow_exact_baseline, and can't be combined with other settings.
The number of nearest neighbor candidates to consider per shard. It can't be less than k, or more than 10000 (9999 with sampling).
If true, the hits were not rescored, so their scores are estimates, and no query is excluded from the mean recall.
The rescoring of the candidates. Only applies to quantized fields.
If true, the number of vectors to rescore exceeded the limit of 10000.
The percentage of postings to visit, from 0 to 100. 0 selects the automatic visit calculation.
